settings.system.largeLibrary.authorsPagi: The Authors page always shows one page at a time.
Past {threshold} authors the page draws {pageSize} at a time. Search keeps searching across all of them, and the A-Z index knows which page each letter is on.
The Authors page always draws a card for every author. With twenty thousand authors that's 180,000 DOM nodes and a search that takes twelve seconds — it's a choice, not a hidden limit.
settings.system.largeLibrary.capInvalid: The cap must be a number of gigabytes, or 0 for no limit.
settings.system.largeLibrary.description: Two limits worth knowing before you run into them. Measured on a test library of 100,000 books.
settings.system.largeLibrary.fulltextCap: The index holds the text of every book and weighs about 1.5 MB per book: at 100,000 books that would be over 150 GB. Once the cap is reached it stops indexing new ones — nothing gets deleted, and what's already there stays searchable. 0 = no limit.
settings.system.largeLibrary.ingestPagin: The Import page always shows one page at a time.
Past {threshold} pending files the Import page shows {pageSize} at a time, and the "Import all" command splits into "Import this page".
The Import page always draws a card for every pending file. With thousands it gets heavy — it's a choice, not a hidden limit.
settings.system.largeLibrary.label: Large libraries
settings.system.largeLibrary.libraryPagi: The Library page always asks for one page at a time, even when there are few books.
Past {threshold} books the Library page asks the server for one page at a time, instead of downloading everything. Below that threshold nothing changes.
The Library page always downloads the entire library. With tens of thousands of books it gets slow — it's a choice, not a hidden limit.
always everything at once, whatever the size
settings.system.largeLibrary.pageSizeDes: How many are requested from the server at a time.
settings.system.largeLibrary.thresholdDe: From how many books up it switches to pages.
